items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: but his last name was – I used to try to spell his name. One day I spelled it. He said no, because his name is not spelled the way that it sounds.

ctx.x: Yeah, Billy is his first name. But he had this – but his last name was – I used to try to spell his name. One day I spelled it. He said no, because his name is not spelled the way that it sounds.
The reason why I mentioned him is that he told me that Bird liked your playing. The exact quote is, he said Bird turned to him and said, “Man, that long-haired nigger sure can play that horn.”
